decisions.statement: A category Monarch takes and reports nothing back for is refused.
A category is named by a page that exists.
A Monarch id resolving other than exactly one page is refused.
A transaction no month sidecar carries is refused rather than written to Monarch alone.
The rule that decided is recorded beside the category rather than left to be inferred.
The row is tagged as machine-touched when its category is set.
Monarch taking a category while no month file moves is refused.

definition: a category set on one transaction, in Monarch and in our copy alike
